nodes.name: 06.01 - Load Accounts for Human Control Sync

parameters.jsCode: const b=$('06.01 - Load Accounts for Human Control Sync').item.json;const cid=String($json['Conversation ID']??'').trim();const mode=String($json['Mode']??'').trim().toUpperCase();if(!cid||!['AI','HUMAN'].includes(mode))return[];return [{json:{businessId:b.business_id,conversationId:cid,mode,status:String($json['Status']??''),sheetRow:$json}}];

parameters.query: WITH target AS (SELECT c.id FROM conversations c JOIN customers cu ON cu.id=c.customer_id WHERE c.id=$1::bigint AND cu.business_id=$2 LIMIT 1),upd AS (UPDATE conversations SET human_mode=($3='HUMAN'),state=CASE WHEN $3='HUMAN' THEN 'HUMAN_REQUIRED' ELSE 'BROWSING' END,mode_source='GOOGLE_SHEET',handoff_reason=CASE WHEN $3='HUMAN' THEN COALESCE(handoff_reason,'SHEET_CONTROL') ELSE NULL END,mode_changed_at=NOW(),updated_at=NOW() WHERE id IN(SELECT id FROM target) RETURNING id),res AS (UPDATE human_handoffs SET status='RESOLVED',resolved_at=NOW(),updated_at=NOW() WHERE conversation_id=$1::bigint AND status='PENDING' AND $3='AI' RETURNING 1),ins AS (INSERT INTO human_handoffs(conversation_id,customer_id,business_id,account_id,reason,source,summary) SELECT c.id,c.customer_id,cu.business_id,cu.account_id,'SHEET_CONTROL','GOOGLE_SHEET','Mode changed to HUMAN from Google Sheet' FROM conversations c JOIN customers cu ON cu.id=c.customer_id WHERE c.id=$1::bigint AND cu.business_id=$2 AND $3='HUMAN' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM human_handoffs WHERE conversation_id=c.id AND status='PENDING') RETURNING id) SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM upd) AS applied,$3::text AS mode;
